test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose ‘No improvement’ as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.**

Though a foreigner, Mother Teresa __settle in Calcutta and__ made it her home.
solution:
The correct answer is: **settled in Calcutta and**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is in the past tense, so the correct form of the verb should be used.
 
• "Settle" should be in the past tense to match the timeline of the action. The past tense of "settle" is "**settled**."
 
• The phrase "and made it her home" is correctly struc
